author: J. B. Steere
journal: Journal of the American Geographical Society of New York
heading_as_printed: Vocabularies from Eight Aboriginal Dialects of the Island of Formosa, Collected by J. B. Steere, University of Michigan, during the winter of 1873-74. Six Lists of Words from the Aboriginal Languages of Formosa.
collector: J. B. Steere; Onlau list furnished by Rev. Mr. Makay (Tamsui); Pilam list furnished by Rev. Mr. Ritchie (Takao)
about: J. B. Steere collected six word lists from the Tsui-whan, Lek-whan, Che-whan, Pepo-whan (from old women at Kongana and Bankimseng) and Kale-whan with the help of a Chinese interpreter in 1873-74, adding lists from Onlau and Pilam supplied by the missionaries Makay and Ritchie.
